LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Corpse_Desc: Consume {0:F0} purified raven liquid to absorb allowed corpses and produce liquid pink meat broth. Connect a pipe output port to send it to raven liquid processors.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Aphrodisiac_Desc: Consume {0:F0} purified raven liquid to apply one aphrodisiac layer to every hostile organic pawn on the map.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Consciousness_Des: Consume {0:F0} purified raven liquid to apply one consciousness suppression layer to every hostile organic pawn on the map.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Filter_Desc: Select corpses accepted by the reclamation pulse and configure how gear and inventory are handled.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Filter_Equipment_: When enabled, apparel and weapons vanish with the corpse. Otherwise they drop at the corpse position.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Filter_Inventory_: When enabled, inventory items are absorbed. Otherwise they drop at the corpse position.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Disabled_NoStorag: The obelisk has no liquid storage component.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Disabled_Liquid: Requires at least {0:F0} purified raven liquid.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_NoTargets: No eligible targets were found. No purified raven liquid was consumed.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Status_Tooltip: Obelisk purified raven liquid storage. Each map-wide pulse consumes {0:F0}.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_BrothOutputBlocke: There is not enough pink meat broth output capacity, so corpses that cannot be processed completely were left intact.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_DebugFill_Desc: God mode command: immediately fill the obelisk storage with purified raven liquid.
LanguageData.RavenRace_ObeliskPulse_Console_OpenDesc: Manage raven liquid storage, pink meat broth, corpse filter and pulse release from a unified interface.
